text: Drain reported 'target met' after landing 20261015-141831-hyb4, a defaults change that did not touch the explainer, and its check against the pinned source passed a page that an independent reader found wrong on three facts (teardown can reopen instead of close, yolo-on self-merge, which handoff frees a place). Only a landing that changed the outcome may count, and the source check must catch statements the source contradicts or leaves out.
